changeSet.author: developer
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE users DISABLE TRIGGER ALL;

INSERT INTO users (username, email, first_name, last_name, age, status, created_at, updated_at, last_login) SELECT 'user_' || generate_series || '_' || floor(random() * 1000000), chr(97 + floor(random() * 26)::int) || chr(97 + floor(random() * 26)::int) || chr(97 + floor(random() * 26)::int) || generate_series || '@' || (ARRAY['gmail.com', 'yahoo.com', 'hotmail.com', 'outlook.com', 'company.com'])[floor(random() * 5 + 1)],
(ARRAY['John','Jane','Michael','Sarah','David','Emma','James','Lisa','Robert','Maria'])[floor(random()*10+1)], (ARRAY['Smith','Johnson','Williams','Brown','Jones','Garcia','Miller','Davis','Rodriguez','Martinez'])[floor(random()*10+1)],
floor(random() * 63 + 18)::int,
(ARRAY['ACTIVE','INACTIVE','BLOCKED'])[floor(random()*3+1)],
CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - random() * interval '365 days',
CASE WHEN random() > 0.3 THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - random() * interval '30 days' ELSE NULL END,
CASE WHEN random() > 0.5 THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - random() * interval '7 days' ELSE NULL END
FROM generate_series(1, 1000000);
